questions.question: What does an arrow painted on the pavement mean?

options.text: Drivers in that lane may make the movement shown by the arrow if they want to.
Drivers in that lane must make the movement shown by the arrow only if traffic lights are not working.
Drivers in that lane must always stop completely before making the movement shown by the arrow.
Drivers in that lane must make the movement shown by the arrow and obey traffic signals.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers in that lane must make the movement shown by the arrow and obey traffic signals.
questions.explanation: An arrow painted on the pavement tells drivers in that lane to make the movement shown by the arrow. Always follow traffic signs and signals before moving in the direction of the arrow.

questions.question: What does a solid white line down the center of a two-lane road mean?

options.text: Traffic moves in opposite directions and drivers cannot pass.
Traffic moves in opposite directions and drivers can pass when safe.
Traffic moves in the same direction and drivers cannot pass.
Traffic moves in the same direction and drivers can pass when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in the same direction and drivers cannot pass.
questions.explanation: White lines separate traffic moving in the same direction. A solid white line means drivers cannot pass.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A crossroad is ahead. Watch for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: A crossroad is ahead. Watch for traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossroad is coming.

questions.question: When backing up, what should you do?

options.text: Open your door to check if it is safe.
Turn your head and look out the rear window.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your head and look out the rear window.
questions.explanation: Always check behind your vehicle before backing up. Children and small objects are hard to see from the driver's seat. Turn your head to see through the rear window while backing. Do not rely only on mirrors or sensors.

questions.question: ____ limit your concentration, perception, judgment, and memory.

options.text: Only a blood alcohol level above the legal limit can
Even a small amount of alcohol can
Only a blood alcohol level above 0.05 percent can

questions.correctAnswerText: Even a small amount of alcohol can
questions.explanation: Even a small amount of alcohol reduces your concentration, perception, judgment, and memory. Your driving skills will suffer. No one can drink and drive safely.

questions.question: What is distracted driving?

options.text: No more dangerous than normal driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Extremely risky behavior.
questions.explanation: Distracted driving is extremely risky. It puts you, your passengers, pedestrians, bicyclists, and other drivers in danger. Stay focused on driving to prevent crashes.

questions.question: What must you do when you see a flashing red traffic signal?
questions.correctAnswerText: Stop before entering the intersection.
questions.explanation: A flashing red light means you must stop. Yield to traffic and pedestrians. Go only when it is safe. At a railroad crossing, a flashing red light means a train is approaching. Yield to the train and go only when the lights stop flashing.

questions.question: What does an orange triangle with red borders on the rear of a vehicle mean?

options.text: The vehicle is a school bus.

questions.correctAnswerText: The vehicle is slow-moving.
questions.explanation: An orange triangle with red borders indicates a slow-moving vehicle. Do not expect this vehicle to go faster than 25 mph.

questions.question: Before turning left, what is important to do?

options.text: Swing to the right side of your lane.
Wait until oncoming traffic has a red light.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield to oncoming vehicles.
questions.explanation: When turning left at a traffic signal, you must let pedestrians and oncoming traffic pass first.

questions.question: An oncoming car is to your left and a bicyclist is to your right. What should you do?

options.text: Let the car pass, then pass the bike.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let the car pass, then pass the bike.
questions.explanation: When there are multiple hazards, handle one at a time. Let the oncoming car pass first, then pass the bicyclist. Do not try to squeeze between both at the same time.

questions.question: If an aggressive driver cuts you off, what should you do?

options.text: Stay calm and move out of their way.
Flash your lights to show the driver they are wrong.
Do something to get back at the aggressive driver.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay calm and move out of their way.
questions.explanation: If an aggressive driver cuts you off, stay calm and get out of their way. Do not try to get even with them. This can make the situation worse and more dangerous.

questions.question: What do round signs mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Railroad crossing ahead.
questions.explanation: Round signs warn you about upcoming railroad crossings. Drive with extra caution when you see these signs.

questions.question: An emergency vehicle is coming toward you with its siren on. What must you do?

options.text: Drive to the nearest intersection and stop.
Pull over to the side and stop, away from any intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull over to the side and stop, away from any intersection.
questions.explanation: When an emergency vehicle with a siren approaches, you must pull to the side of the road and stop. Stay there until the emergency vehicle passes.

questions.question: How should small children ride in a vehicle?

options.text: They can be safely held by a strong adult.
They are safe if standing on the floor in the back.
They will not get hurt in an accident because they are small.
They must never stand up while the vehicle is moving.

questions.correctAnswerText: They must never stand up while the vehicle is moving.
questions.explanation: Use special child safety seats for small children. No adult is strong enough to hold a child safely during an accident or sudden stop. Always keep children properly secured in their seats.

questions.question: What do work zone signs mean?

options.text: You must stop and back up immediately.
You should drive faster to leave the work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: Difficult driving conditions are present.
questions.explanation: Work zone signs are orange and warn you that work is happening on or near the road. Be very careful when you see these signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Keep right.
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers to keep right. It warns you to avoid a hazard ahead on the left side of the road.

questions.question: At what blood alcohol concentration (BAC) are you presumed to be driving under the influence?
questions.correctAnswerText: 0.08 percent.
questions.explanation: You will face legal consequences if your blood alcohol concentration (BAC) is 0.08 percent or higher. Driving under the influence of alcohol or drugs is a serious safety risk.

questions.question: If you stop at a railroad crossing with more than one track, what should you do?

options.text: Wait until you can see clearly down all tracks.
Stop on the first track and watch for another train.
Go through as soon as the train passes.
Go through when one track is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wait until you can see clearly down all tracks.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing with more than one track, do not move until you can see clearly down all tracks. Another train may be coming on a different track.

questions.question: If another car is about to hit you, what should you do?
questions.correctAnswerText: Sound your horn.
questions.explanation: Use your horn to warn other drivers or pedestrians who may not see you. For example, sound your horn if you think another driver is about to hit you.

questions.question: If your vehicle begins to skid, what should you do?

options.text: Turn your steering wheel into traffic.
Turn your steering wheel in the direction of the skid.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn your steering wheel in the direction of the skid.
questions.explanation: If your vehicle skids, stay calm. Turn the steering wheel in the direction of the skid.
